executionScope: Actual separately owned DSH and headless Chromium, real registered tools and native engines. No user desktop control or user DSH restart.
buildScope: Cases ran across repaired UI151-UI154 live development files; UI154 had reviewed frontend edits before the UI155 version freeze. Final package load is a separate check. Do not claim every case reran on an immutable UI155 artifact.
ledgerDigestInterpretation: The original UI runner hashed normalized UTF-8 read_text strings, not Windows CRLF file bytes. All normalized digests were matched; each current report also records the actual executed-file byte digest. Original ledgers are preserved.
